data.name: Krampus
data.detailed_description:
You find yourself trapped inside an old house filled with secrets and danger. With every door locked and no obvious way out, your only goal is to escape.

Explore eerie rooms, dark hallways, and a terrifying basement as you search for clues, collect useful items, and solve puzzles that reveal new paths forward. But you're not alone.

Krampus is hunting you.

He roams the house, listening for every sound. A thrown object can distract him and create an opportunity to slip by unnoticed, but one careless noise may reveal your location. Stay hidden, use your surroundings wisely, and avoid being caught.

As you explore the house and the area outside, you'll uncover hidden secrets and discover multiple ways your story can end. Every decision brings you closer to freedom—or to Krampus.

Features

  • First-person horror experience.

  • A relentless enemy that reacts to sound.

  • Use objects to distract Krampus and create opportunities to escape.

  • Challenging puzzles and hidden secrets.

  • Explore a large house, basement, and outdoor areas.

  • Multiple endings.

  • Tense atmosphere with constant danger and suspense.

Can you find a way out before Krampus finds you?
